mapper.sql: select fi.id, fi.category_id, fc.name as category_name, fi.title, fi.image, fi.description, fi.content, fi.like_count, fi.favorite_count, fi.comment_count, fi.status, coalesce(nullif(u.nick_name, ''), fi.create_by) as author_name, fi.create_time, (select count(1) from food_like fl where fl.food_id = fi.id and fl.user_id = #{userId}) as liked, (select count(1) from food_favorite ff where ff.food_id = fi.id and ff.user_id = #{userId}) as favorited from food_info fi left join food_category fc on fc.id = fi.category_id left join sys_user u on u.user_name = fi.create_by
mapper.select:
fi.status = '0'
and (fi.title like concat('%', #{title}, '%') or fi.description like concat('%', #{title}, '%'))
and fi.category_id = #{categoryId}
order by fi.create_time desc, fi.id desc

select fi.id, fi.category_id, fc.name as category_name, fi.title, fi.image, fi.description, fi.content, fi.like_count, fi.favorite_count, fi.comment_count, fi.status, coalesce(nullif(u.nick_name, ''), fi.create_by) as author_name, fi.create_time, (select count(1) from food_like fl where fl.food_id = fi.id and fl.user_id = #{userId}) as liked, 1 as favorited from food_favorite ff inner join food_info fi on fi.id = ff.food_id left join food_category fc on fc.id = fi.category_id left join sys_user u on u.user_name = fi.create_by where ff.user_id = #{userId} order by ff.create_time desc, ff.id desc

select c.id, c.food_id, c.user_id, u.nick_name, u.avatar, c.content, c.parent_id, p.content as parent_content, pu.nick_name as parent_nick_name, c.create_time from food_comment c left join sys_user u on u.user_id = c.user_id left join food_comment p on p.id = c.parent_id left join sys_user pu on pu.user_id = p.user_id where c.food_id = #{foodId} and c.status = '0' order by c.create_time asc, c.id asc

select c.id, c.food_id, fi.title as food_title, fi.image as food_image, c.user_id, u.nick_name, u.avatar, c.content, c.parent_id, p.content as parent_content, pu.nick_name as parent_nick_name, c.create_time from food_comment c left join food_info fi on fi.id = c.food_id left join sys_user u on u.user_id = c.user_id left join food_comment p on p.id = c.parent_id left join sys_user pu on pu.user_id = p.user_id where c.user_id = #{userId} order by c.create_time desc, c.id desc

select c.id, c.food_id, fi.title as food_title, fi.image as food_image, c.user_id, u.nick_name, u.avatar, c.content, c.parent_id, p.content as parent_content, pu.nick_name as parent_nick_name, c.create_time from food_comment c inner join food_info fi on fi.id = c.food_id and fi.create_by = #{userName} left join sys_user u on u.user_id = c.user_id left join food_comment p on p.id = c.parent_id left join sys_user pu on pu.user_id = p.user_id where c.user_id != (select user_id from sys_user where user_name = #{userName} limit 1) order by c.create_time desc, c.id desc
select count(1) from food_info where create_by = #{userName}
select count(1) from food_favorite where user_id = #{userId}
select count(1) from food_comment where user_id = #{userId}
